description: Use this when the user asks about a registrar: its country, group, size (gTLD domains under management), how many extensions it sells, and how fresh our prices for it are. Accepts our id, its name or an IANA id.

registrar.description: a registrar's id (porkbun), name (Porkbun) or IANA id (1861)

name: get_registrar

family.description: the group it belongs to (several brands, one owner)

anyOf.description: A short, sourced note about the registrar's prices (not a price we rank by).

examples: NameSilo's free discount program prices .com at $12.00 (retail $19.99).

url.description: where the note's facts come from

pricing_tier.description: retail: anyone can buy at these prices; reseller: the prices are a reseller account's tier (eNom's Silver), left out of consumer rankings unless include_resellers=true

rank.description: by gTLD domains under management (ICANN monthly registry reports), registrar groups counted together

url.description: the page on tldbench.com with the full comparison

title: Registrar profile
